labelOrigin: Held out from version 0.5.0: mined after 0.5.0 was released, from fix commits not used during its development, and labelled from each fix commit's message and diff before the checker was run on either revision. siteLines are lines of the buggy (parent) revision in file: the queueing call and the access or lifetime end it races with. translationUnit is the source analyzed when file is a header.
matching: A case is found when the parent revision has a CL1-CL4 diagnostic whose primary location or any code-flow location in the labelled file is on one of siteLines; the fix silences it when the fixed revision has no such diagnostic.

cases.bug: The stack std::vector all_active is the source of an H2D cudaMemcpyAsync on stream and is destroyed when the function returns, before the copy is known to have read it; the fix synchronizes the stream before returning.

raft::copy queues a D2H copy of the dataset into the host matrix h_dataset, and to_file writes h_dataset to disk without synchronizing the stream; the fix adds raft::resource::sync_stream before each to_file.

The host transform copies the quantizer's device threshold into the host vector threshold_vec with raft::copy (D2H, asynchronous) and the OpenMP loop then reads threshold_ptr[in_j] without synchronizing; the fix synchronizes the stream before the loop.

In the data_on_host branch, raft::copy queues a D2H copy of the dataset into database_h, which is passed to all_neighbors::build without synchronizing (the output_on_host branch above synchronizes); the fix adds raft::resource::sync_stream after the copy.

min_d.set_value_async(val, stream) queues an H2D copy from the local val, and the next line overwrites val for max_d before the first copy is known to have read it; the fix gives each copy its own constant source.

rmm::device_scalar<math_t> cublas_alpha(1.0, stream) queues an H2D copy from a temporary math_t that ends with the full expression, before the copy is known to have read it; the fix replaces the device scalars with host constants.

prev_mst_edge_count.set_value_async(curr_mst_edge_count, stream) queues an H2D copy from curr_mst_edge_count, a local of the loop body that ends with the iteration; the fix synchronizes the stream after the call.
The conversion queues a D2H update_host into the local v and returns v, reading it, without synchronizing the stream; the fix synchronizes after the copy.

rmm::device_scalar<vertex_t> d_source(bfs_usecase.source, stream) binds its const reference to a vertex_t temporary converted from the size_t source and queues an H2D copy from it; the temporary ends with the full expression before the copy is known to have read it. The fix copies from a named local and synchronizes.

The fill kernel reading the scratch value_devptr is launched on the current stream, and wp_free_device then frees the scratch with a stream-ordered free on the legacy stream, which does not wait for a non-blocking current stream; the fix frees it on the stream that used it.
